annotations.title: Get an event in compact form

description: Use when an agent needs the current state of one prediction-market event without every field of every market: the compact form of get_event. Returns the title, venue, status, close time, the event's volume with its unit, and up to 20 outcomes (by price when they are mutually exclusive, else by volume), each with its probability, 24-hour change, 24-hour volume and market id; on a market whose outcomes are not Yes/No, `priced_outcome` names the outcome the price is for. Untraded markets carry no probability, and `cite_as` says when the event has no traded price. The venue's rules text appears once, for the first outcome listed. A closed event, including one archived 10 days after it closed, returns its resolved form: the winner where the venue reported one, each outcome's result and final recorded price, and when it closed. `_meta` carries `cite_as`, `data_as_of` and links to the full record and the price history. Units: `probability`, `change_24h` and `final_price` are on a 0-1 scale (0.62 = 62%; `change_24h` 0.05 = up 5 points); volumes are in `volume_unit`, the venue's own unit, never converted between venues; times are UTC. Call get_event for every market with every field.
